steps.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: 4/4 pages transcribed; 1/4 pages deciphered; 3 more in part; 851 elements,547 identified (64.3%). Report section: see report.
